tasks.short: Teach public fire safety and prevention.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual fire safety topics, audience needs and approved prevention resources
inputs: actual programme objectives and audience
actual current approved prevention resources
outputs: checked actual fire education content choices

steps.what: Prepare actual public education materials from chosen fire safety and prevention content
inputs: checked actual fire education content choices
actual instructor teaching objectives and audience explanation choices
outputs: complete actual public fire education material draft

loop.input: Actual approved source content and instructor choices
loop.check: Instructor checks safety meaning, omitted precautions, unsupported instructions and audience comprehension
loop.stop: Missing actual approved instruction or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native teaching headings and approved resource blocks first; audience explanations vary

steps.what: Check final fire education materials against approved instructions and actual audience needs
inputs: complete actual public fire education material draft
checked actual fire education content choices
outputs: checked final actual fire education materials

steps.what: Save the checked final actual fire education materials
inputs: checked final actual fire education materials
outputs: saved actual fire education materials

steps.what: Teach actual public education programs on fire safety and prevention
inputs: checked final actual fire education materials
actual participants, questions and practice
outputs: actual public instruction, demonstration and feedback

tasks.design: Configure native approved-resource links and teaching fields in {DOCS} and {LMS}, then bound material drafting to actual instructor choices. Retain full safety review, save the final material and keep all actual public teaching, demonstration and questions with the instructor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Education preparation can repeat approved-source navigation and explanation writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native resource reuse and bounded drafting can reduce actual material preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Safe public understanding requires actual teaching and feedback.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor recognises misunderstood fire advice and adapts explanation.
tasks.altitude: Less material preparation; public teaching stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native approved-resource links and bounded drafting can support fire education materials; they do not establish safe instructions or teach participants.

assumptions: Actual programme/source owners supply current approved resources; instructor checks them in s1 and captures/corrects actual audience explanation choices within retained s2. Missing safety content remains manual.

Actual new/revised preparation is counted once per programme version, not per attendee or repeated delivery. If using unchanged resources, remove preparation branch and reweight; no invented writing baseline.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native approved blocks first; existing material assembly earns zero saving. Complete safety review and all teaching remain retained. Save retains one percent using existing final check.
No attendance record/report or electronic material send is required by the stated teaching duty; any actual additional record/release must be decomposed and final-version gated separately.
unknowns: How often are materials actually revised?
research_questions: Does drafting reduce actual preparation after complete safety/audience review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual teaching explanation within s2.

incremental.description: Maintain actual approved-resource links and material checks.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual fire education materials and exact internal destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation + 14*0.30 prose = 10.2; minus 1 upkeep = 9.2. Half eligible gives 5.1 minus 1 = 4.1. Full safety review, save and actual teaching retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend fire-prevention and inspection procedure changes.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual fire prevention, inspection and fire code endorsement procedures and findings
inputs: actual current procedures and applicable source versions
actual inspection findings and procedural feedback
outputs: checked actual procedural improvement evidence

steps.what: Evaluate actual procedural problems and choose justified recommended changes
inputs: checked actual procedural improvement evidence
actual operational constraints and responsible owners
outputs: actual chosen recommendations, rationale and limitations

steps.what: Write recommended changes to fire prevention, inspection and fire code endorsement procedures
inputs: actual chosen recommendations, rationale and limitations
checked actual procedural improvement evidence
outputs: complete actual procedural recommendation draft

loop.purpose: Draft procedural recommendations from actual inspector choices
loop.input: Current procedures, chosen changes and checked supporting findings
loop.check: Inspector checks operational meaning, omitted conditions, source fidelity and unsupported legal/safety claims
loop.stop: Missing actual recommended change or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tracked-change fields and headings first; procedural explanations vary

steps.what: Check final procedural recommendations and exact responsible decision-maker destinations
inputs: complete actual procedural recommendation draft
actual chosen recommendations, rationale and limitations
outputs: checked final actual recommendation and recipient list

steps.what: Save the checked final procedural recommendation
inputs: checked final actual recommendation and recipient list
outputs: saved actual procedural recommendation

steps.what: Send exact checked recommendations to actual responsible procedure decision makers
inputs: checked final actual recommendation and recipient list
outputs: delivered actual procedural recommendations for decision

tasks.design: Configure native procedure/source links in inspection case software {OTHER} and {DOCS}, then bound tracked recommendation drafting to actual inspector choices. Retain evaluation and complete final review before separate save and delivery to actual decision makers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recommendations can repeat evidence navigation and prose after procedural decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and bounded tracked drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate procedure changes require operational and evidential judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector recognises a proposed shortcut that would weaken prevention or inspection.
tasks.altitude: Less recommendation production; procedural judgement remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native procedure/source links and bounded tracked drafting can support recommendations; they do not establish legal correctness or enact procedure changes.

assumptions: Actual procedure/case owners supply current versions and real findings; inspector checks sources in s1 and chooses changes in s2. Missing actual evidence or authority remains unresolved, not invented.
Retained s3 captures/corrects actual recommendation meaning; complete final check stays in s4. Native tracked fields first; existing document assembly earns zero saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Actual written recommendation branch only; oral-only recommendation removes unused writing/delivery and reweights. Save/send each retain one percent using existing final check.
The task recommends, not enacts. Actual procedure owner decides after exact final recommendation exists; no new rulemaking authority or avoided owner approval labour claimed.
unknowns: Which evidence navigation and recommendation prose repeats?
research_questions: Does drafting reduce writing after complete procedural review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual recommendation meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual procedure/source links and drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual recommendation and exact internal destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final actual recommendation and exact responsible recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.40 evidence navigation + 20*0.30 prose = 16; minus 1 upkeep = 15. Half eligible gives 8 minus 1 = 7. Evaluation, full final check and actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Subpoena and interview witnesses for information and sworn testimony.

steps.what: Prepare and check actual authorised subpoena, witness identity, scope and service destination
inputs: actual case need and witness details
actual authorised subpoena decision and permitted form
outputs: checked final actual authorised subpoena and exact service destination

steps.what: Issue the exact checked authorised subpoena through the actual permitted service channel
inputs: checked final actual authorised subpoena and exact service destination
outputs: actual subpoena issued for permitted service

steps.what: Interview actual witnesses, property owners and building occupants for information and sworn testimony
inputs: actual case questions and witnesses
actual applicable testimony conditions and witness responses
outputs: actual obtained witness information and testimony

steps.what: Capture and check actual witness statements, source identity and testimony status
inputs: actual obtained witness information and testimony
actual interview date, witness identity and testimony conditions
outputs: checked final actual witness statement record

steps.what: Commit the checked final actual witness statement record
inputs: checked final actual witness statement record
outputs: committed actual witness information/testimony record

tasks.design: Configure native authorised-form fields in investigation case software {OTHER} and {DOCS}. Retain actual subpoena authority/content checking, all interviews and precise statement capture; issue only the exact authorised subpoena and separately commit the checked testimony record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Subpoena preparation can repeat verified case/witness identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native authorised-form fields can reduce repeated identifiers and headings.
tasks.still_hard: Compulsory process authority and reliable witness information require actual professional handling.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator distinguishes a witness account from a verified fact and actual sworn testimony.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated form entry; witness interviewing remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native authorised-form fields can reuse case/witness identifiers; they do not authorise subpoenas, serve process or obtain truthful testimony.

assumptions: Actual case/witness owners supply identity and actual authorised decision/form; investigator checks exact final content/authority in retained s1. Only repeated identifiers/headings lose time; no automatic legal decision.

Any required judge/authorised official must approve the exact final subpoena after it exists before s2; no new issuing power or avoided official labour assumed. S2 is only actual delegated issue/service-channel action; physical service stays with actual authorised people and earns no saving.
Actual interview, primary statement capture and complete source/testimony-status checks stay retained in s3/s4. No automatic credibility judgement or inferred sworn status.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Subpoena and voluntary interview are alternative actual branches; remove unused compulsory process and reweight. Native fields first; existing prefill earns zero saving. Issue/commit each retain one percent using actual existing final checks.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce typing after complete identity, authority and final-content checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual authorised form/case field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s1 checked final actual subpoena, actual required official authorisation and exact permitted service destination; edits void approval
s4 checked final actual witness statement record and exact case/witness destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.20 repeated form fields = 5; minus 1 upkeep = 4. Half eligible gives 2.5 minus 1 = 1.5. Authority checks, interview, actual statements and actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate employee negligence or legal violations.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual complaint, employee records and applicable procedure/source versions
inputs: actual internal investigation mandate and complaint
actual permitted records and relevant rules/procedures
outputs: checked actual internal-investigation evidence scope

steps.what: Conduct internal investigation to determine actual employee negligence and violations of laws or regulations
inputs: checked actual internal-investigation evidence scope
actual interviews, observations, source records and employee responses
outputs: actual investigated findings, supporting evidence and unresolved allegations

steps.what: Write and check actual internal-investigation report and exact permitted decision-maker recipients
inputs: actual investigated findings, supporting evidence and unresolved allegations
checked actual internal-investigation evidence scope
outputs: checked final actual internal-investigation report and permitted recipients

loop.purpose: Draft investigation report from actual findings
loop.input: Actual investigator findings, verified evidence and unresolved allegations
loop.output: Source-linked internal-investigation draft for full checking
loop.check: Investigator checks allegation versus finding, omitted employee response, source fidelity, confidentiality and unsupported legal conclusions
loop.stop: Missing actual finding/source or two failed revisions returns report writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native investigation headings and evidence fields first; factual explanations vary

steps.what: Save the exact checked final internal-investigation report
inputs: checked final actual internal-investigation report and permitted recipients
outputs: saved actual internal-investigation report

steps.what: Send exact checked investigation report to actual authorised decision makers
inputs: checked final actual internal-investigation report and permitted recipients
outputs: delivered actual internal-investigation findings

tasks.design: Configure native permitted case/source links in investigation software {OTHER} and {DOCS}, then bound report drafting to actual investigated findings. Retain all investigation, primary evidence capture and complete final report checks before separate save and delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Internal investigation can repeat source navigation and factual report prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and bounded narrative drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Fair investigation and defensible findings require actual evidence and professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The investigator distinguishes an allegation from a substantiated finding and records contrary evidence.
tasks.altitude: Less report preparation; investigation remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source links and bounded narrative drafting can support internal-investigation reporting; they do not determine employee guilt, legal liability or disciplinary action.

assumptions: Actual authorised investigation owner supplies mandate and permitted records; investigator checks relevance/access in s1. Actual interviews, evidence capture, interpretation and conclusions remain fully retained in s2.

Retained s3 includes capture/correction of actual findings and full final evidence, contrary-response and recipient checks after complete draft exists. Drafting does not establish negligence or legal violation.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native fields first; existing report automation earns zero saving. Actual written report/delivery branches only; remove absent branches and reweight actual work.

Save/send each retain one percent using existing final check. Actual authorised owners retain any disciplinary/legal decision after final findings exist; no new decision rights or avoided owner labour claimed.
unknowns: Which actual source navigation/report prose repeats?
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce reporting after complete fair-evidence review?

already_counted.description: Capture actual report meaning and perform full final checking within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual permitted source links and investigation-report checks.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual internal-investigation report and exact permitted case destination; edits require recheck
s3 checked final actual investigation report and exact authorised recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 navigation + 18*0.20 prose = 11.6; minus 1.5 upkeep = 10.1. Half eligible gives 5.8 minus 1.5 = 4.3. Investigation, full final report checks and actions retained.
